lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. One decision is asked of Brandon: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first.

The twelfth publish is live since 00:12 UTC (5:12 PM MT Friday). It holds round two: the build of commit 349bdc60, which is round two's main 48a2e3b7 with its own first pictures. Before it went out, measured here: tsc exit 0; the whole test run exit 0 with 1048 passed and 9 skipped; the page's 40 first pictures agree with the page's framing; a second build without the sounds gave the same 17 files as the security reviewer read. The fifteenth security reviewer found nothing that blocks and gave no warning (stated). A helper read the same build in a browser on its machine before the upload: nine loads, three real shakes, no page message, 33 buttons (stated by it; I looked at its two sheets). After the upload the page answers 200 and equals the local page up to the body's end, three files are equal by hash, and a request without a sign in is refused with 401 on three paths. Visibility: Organization. Not verified: a real graphics card, a phone, Safari, Firefox, the sound as heard, the live address itself in a signed in browser.

Where each season stands after two rounds, by fresh critics who had his settled lines (stated by them, round one's score in brackets) and by my eye beside the approved pictures. Winter 8 of 10 (not judged again, round two did not move it): the nearest to its approved picture; four small items have no builder. Summer 7 (5): base, lawn and sun flare are close; at the landing the storm still hides the whole miniature where the approved lets the cottage and the tree show through, the seeds at rest are larger than the approved's fine sparks, and the base reads browner than the approved's pale cream. Fall 6 (5): tree and base are nearer; the air inside is greener and flatter than the approved's dark warm air (a darker air is accepted for the next measuring run), and from the close camera the near fence and the pumpkin's cut face are rough. Spring 6 (6): it reads as the approved at feed size; the glass is bare after a shake against his settled line (ordered mended), the fence is pickets where the approved has two rails, and the trails at rest read as white streaks. The change of season 8 (not judged again). Against his own bar of 9 with 7 as the least: winter, summer and the change are at or over 7, spring and fall are under it by the critics, and none is at 9.

The ask. If he says move on: the late pieces land (fall's darker air, the petals' smear, spring's glass, the patch for the stall at low quality if it comes whole, summer's swirl if its proof holds), then the tree is frozen, the repo goes private, Preview 07 shows the whole film with sound, and the full 4K 60 render starts on his gaming PC on his word. If he says one more round: it goes to spring and fall first, about three hours by round two's pace, and the same late pieces land meanwhile. The late pieces and the render instructions go on in either case. Only the freeze waits.

Landed since Status 235, each stated by its helper. Summer's see through swirl at 4K: both readings are in, film frames 1436 to 1444 at the masters' tier. One frame events in the measured box: main 22.5 to 24.4 percent, the swirl 23.7 to 25.9 percent. The helper's eye on the swirl: cottage, lamp post and trunk read through a pale veil, and a few small green pieces stand as two to four thin bars side by side. Not ruled yet; I look at the cuts first. The merged tree's film frames 668 to 671 at 4K are drawn (425 to 783 s a frame), not looked at yet. The patch for the stall at low quality is not whole: the wait it was written for is gone (0 of 12 presses, 4 of 8 before), but a second stand of about one to two seconds in the first frames after a press shows at low into summer in two of three runs; its builder traced it to the browser's commit while the software renderer is busy and found it on main before the patch too. Whole report about 00:52 UTC (5:52 PM MT).

The final render on his own computer: the builder of the one file for Claude Code is at work since 23:06 UTC (4:06 PM MT); no report from it yet and its branch is not on origin yet. No final render is started in the cloud.

Open: spring's glass at the landing (ordered, report about 01:17 UTC, 6:17 PM MT), summer's see through at the landing (to be ruled), the stall at low quality (not whole), winter's four items (no builder in round two), fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face from the close camera (item 272), a faint saw tooth in the grass left of summer's pond (item 270), the petals' fringe at film frame 680, a nudge at film frames 2113 to 2117, a fine grain inside the petals' smear, the poster tool that stops on one failed request without keeping the reason (item 273).
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 00:13 UTC, 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 06.
